mediaBrief.imagePrompt: Candid smartphone snapshot, slight tilt, natural color balance, neutral white balance. A close-up phone screenshot of a forged MCHD email header displayed on a cracked smartphone screen, taken at an angle from above. The device lies on a wooden desk in a dimly lit home office, one hand resting on the edge of the frame. The screen shows a red banner across the top, partially obscured by a coffee ring. The email header reads, The background is blurred, showing a bookshelf with medical journals and a framed certificate on the wall. The lighting is warm and uneven, casting a soft shadow from the phone’s edge. The image has a slight lens flare and a faint fingerprint smudge on the lower right corner. The phone is not held by anyone; it is stationary, as if left behind. Setting: a mass vaccination clinic in a school gymnasium: lines of residents, nurses at folding tables, signs with arrows, volunteers in vests, daylight through high windows
